findings.text: the clock assertion compares the row's observed_at against the same `stalled` value the test handed to its own fixture, so both sides move together and it holds whatever the code does; the durability it appears to give is not independent of the value under test.

baseline_suite and after_suite carry prose summaries rather than the armed JSON (revision, command, exit_status, log_path, completed, failure_count, failure_ids), so the added-failure set has to be re-derived from gate-base.log and gate-after.log instead of read; three added ids are recoverable and are recorded here.

this file is outside the node's declared write path list (reckon/crew_follow_commands.py, reckon/crew/ticker.py, the new test, the evidence fragment and figure dir); the edit is disclosed in the manifest's scope_note and is legitimate because the old assertion encoded the superseded rule, but it is still an undeclared path.
